description: This file defines the ChatScreen widget for a Flutter app, implementing the UI and logic for a chat interface with suggestions, a mascot, a daily quiz CTA, and message list. It manages user input, message display, and interactions with a ChatProvider for state management.

classes.name: ChatScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main chat interface screen with header, mascot, suggestions, message list, and input controls.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the ChatScreen widget, returning an instance of _ChatScreenState.

methods.name: _ChatScreenState
methods.description: State class managing the chat screen's UI state, including user input, message list, and interactions with the chat provider.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes controllers, sets up listeners for input changes, and prepares initial state.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _showDailyQuizSnack
methods.description: Displays a SnackBar indicating the Daily Quiz feature is coming soon.

methods.name: _insertSuggestion
methods.description: Inserts a suggested prompt into the chat input and sends it via the provider.

methods.name: _send
methods.description: Sends the current message input to the chat provider, then clears the input field.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the chat screen, including header, message list, suggestion chips, input area, and interactions.
